injuries.name: Rasmus Ristolainen
injuries.note: Ristolainen's placement on injured reserve was expected after head coach Rick Tocchet announced that the 32-year-old blueliner would miss roughly two weeks. Ristolainen had already missed nine games due to the same hand issue earlier in the season, but the injury flared back up in Saturday's clash against the Ducks. When healthy, he's been solid with a goal, five shots on net, seven hits and seven blocked shots across four appearances this season. In his absence, Cam York has been activated off injured reserve and should take on some of the minutes vacated by Ristolainen.

injuries.name: Owen Tippett
injuries.note: Tippett will miss his second straight game against Colorado on Monday due to an upper-body injury, and he won't be eligible to play against Buffalo on Wednesday. However, it's unclear when he will be available to return. Tippett has contributed one goal, two points, 21 shots on net and 23 hits in nine appearances this season.

injuries.name: Travis Konecny
injuries.note: Konecny sat out Saturday's 5-1 loss to Boston and will miss additional time after moving to the IR list. It's unclear when he will be ready to return to the lineup, but he won't be an option for at least the next three games, starting with Sunday's matchup against Carolina.

injuries.name: Nikita Grebenkin
injuries.note: Grebenkin's upper-body injury has been revealed to be an issue with his back, which he has successfully had repaired. The 23-year-old winger is expected to miss the majority of the 2026-27 campaign, but his current timeline for return, barring any setbacks, projects him back sometime after the All-Star break in mid-February. When he does return, Grebenkin will look to build off a positive rookie campaign, where he compiled four goals, 14 points, 32 shots on net, 86 hits and 17 blocked shots across 55 regular-season outings in 2025-26.

injuries.name: Isac Lundestrom
injuries.note: Achilles: The Columbus Blue Jackets placed F Isac Lundestrom on long-term injured reserve and was labeled month-to-month by general manager Rick Bowness, per Mark Scheig of The Hockey Writers.

injuries.name: Caleb MacDonald
injuries.note: Lower-Body: The Columbus Blue Jackets placed D Caleb MacDonald on non-roster injured reserve.

injuries.name: Ivan Provorov
injuries.note: Lower-Body: The Columbus Blue Jackets said on Tuesday (Oct. 20) that Provorov is expected to remain sidelined on injured reserve on a week-to-week basis, per Mark Scheig of The Hockey Writers.

injuries.name: Nikita Grebenkin
injuries.note: Upper-body: The Philadelphia Flyers placed F Nikita Grebenkin on injured reserve and is expected to miss at least four months.
